  Four house rules, all enforced by render.py's lint pass:

  1. Section numbers are TYPED into the heading text ("2.1 Findings"), not
     generated. Quarto's number-sections is off.

     hand: "**Table 1. …**". Keep them sequential with
     `python3 <skill>/scripts/renumber_titles.py report.qmd`.
  3. NEVER use Quarto cross-reference anchors ({#fig-…}, {#tbl-…}). They make
     Word offer to repair the file. See SKILL.md.
  4. NEVER cite a figure or table by NUMBER in the prose. Write "the table
     below", or cite the section. Numbers get reassigned; references do not.

  Every Heading 1 starts a new page automatically -- do not add page breaks.
  Tables pick up the house look from the style; no extra markup is needed.
